headline: 兩位演藝界巨星辭世
context: 美國演員露易絲·拉瑟（Louise Lasser）辭世，享壽87歲，她以1970年代邪典喜劇《瑪麗哈特曼，瑪麗哈特曼》(Mary Hartman, Mary Hartman) 走紅，也曾與前夫伍迪·艾倫（Woody Allen）合作多部電影。威爾斯歌手邦妮·泰勒（Bonnie Tyler）也辭世，享壽75歲，代表作《Total Eclipse of the Heart》是1980年代的經典金曲。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: The 1970s soap parody made a household name of Lasser, who was also known for her collaborations with ex-husband Allen and later films including Requiem for a Dream Louise Lasser, star of cult 70s sitcom Mary Hartman, Mary Hartman and early films by Woody Allen (to whom she was married for four years), has died aged 87. The New York Times reported she died “at home in Manhattan” . Lasser’s role as a satirically conceived housewife in suburban Ohio in Mary Hartman, Mary Hartman, designed as a parody of daytime soap operas, made her a national star, landing her on the cover of People magazine and Rolling Stone. The series lasted a year and a half, between January 1976 and July 1977, but due to its five-days-a-week schedule squeezed more than 300 episodes out of its two season run. Lasser’s Hartman, with her signature pigtails, was preoccupied with domestic minutiae but found herself in unsettling and disturbing situations, including bizarre deaths. The show was intended to explore the changes sweeping ordinary life in the US in the 1970s. Continue reading...

A message on her Facebook page reads: “Bonnie’s family and team are heartbroken to announce that Bonnie unexpectedly passed away last night in hospital in Portugal as a result of the illness that she was being treated for.” Continue reading...

thread_text:
兩位演藝界巨星辭世

演藝圈這幾天接連傳出消息。美國演員露易絲·拉瑟（Louise Lasser）辭世，享壽87歲，她以1970年代邪典喜劇《瑪麗哈特曼，瑪麗哈特曼》(Mary Hartman, Mary Hartman) 走紅，也曾與前夫伍迪·艾倫（Woody Allen）合作多部電影，晚年還演出過《噩夢輓歌》(Requiem for a Dream)。

威爾斯歌手邦妮·泰勒（Bonnie Tyler）也辭世，享壽75歲。她的代表作《Total Eclipse of the Heart》是1980年代經典金曲，也唱過電影《渾身是勁》(Footloose)的主題曲，還曾代表英國參加歐洲歌唱大賽。

本則整理自 The Guardian 與 The New York Times 於 2026 年 7 月 9 日及 10 日發佈的報導。
threads_text:
兩位演藝界巨星辭世

演藝圈這幾天接連傳出消息。美國演員露易絲·拉瑟（Louise Lasser）辭世，享壽87歲，她以1970年代邪典喜劇《瑪麗哈特曼，瑪麗哈特曼》走紅，也曾與前夫伍迪·艾倫合作多部電影，晚年還演出過《噩夢輓歌》。

威爾斯歌手邦妮·泰勒也辭世，享壽75歲。紐約時報形容她的嗓音兼具滄桑與歌劇感，打造出多首八零年代的流行金曲，代表作《Total Eclipse of the Heart》至今仍是經典，她也曾代表英國參加歐洲歌唱大賽。

本則整理自 The Guardian 與 The New York Times 於 2026 年 7 月 9 日及 10 日發佈的報導。
voice_text: 演藝圈接連走了兩位資深演藝人員。美國演員露易絲·拉瑟辭世，享壽87歲，她以1970年代邪典喜劇《瑪麗哈特曼，瑪麗哈特曼》走紅，也曾與前夫伍迪·艾倫合作多部電影，晚年還演出過《噩夢輓歌》。差不多同一時間，威爾斯歌手邦妮·泰勒也辭世了，享壽75歲。她的代表作《Total Eclipse of the Heart》是八零年代的經典金曲，也唱過電影《渾身是勁》的主題曲，還曾代表英國參加歐洲歌唱大賽。
